title: Turtle Wax Microfibre Cloth 400 GSM for Cars, Motorcycles, Kitchen, Household Cleaning, 40x40 (2)
description: ✔ Ultra-Soft & High Absorbency – Made from premium 400 GSM microfiber, this cloth provides superior absorption and streak-free cleaning for cars, bikes, kitchen, and household surfaces. ✔ Scratch-Free & Lint-Free – The non-abrasive fibers ensure a scratch-free shine, making it safe for delicate surfaces like car paint, glass, mirrors, and electronics. ✔ Multipurpose Cleaning Cloth – Ideal for drying, dusting, polishing, and waxing; suitable for cars, motorcycles, kitchen counters, furniture, glass, and stainless steel. ✔ Durable & Reusable – Long-lasting, machine-washable fabric retains softness and absorbency even after multiple washes, offering excellent value for money. ✔ Quick-Drying & Easy to Use – Dries faster than regular towels, making it perfect for waterless car washing, home cleaning, and detailing tasks.

specifications.Product Care Instructions: Machine washable in cold or warm water with mild detergent. Tumble dry low or air dry.
